name: ARA2502
title: Not joined
summary: The session called a collaboration method that needs a participant (presence, replica submits, per-participant undo, branch approval) without joining first.
html:
The session called a collaboration method that needs a participant (presence, replica submits, per-participant undo, branch approval) without joining first.

#Common causes

  • collab.join was never called for this session, or the session left.

#Fixes

  • Call collab.join with the session handle, then retry.

  • Code: ARA2502

  • Constant: collab::NOT_JOINED

  • Reported by: ara-collab
